description: Use this when the user plans a trip for a group: school or kindergarten outing (wycieczka szkolna, wycieczka przedszkolna), company team-building (integracja firmowa, wyjazd integracyjny), family day or another group visit to the Jura region or to a horse riding centre. Returns Horseback activities (with and without horses - no riding skills needed for many of them), current prices, opening hours, location, cancellation policy and how to send an inquiry. Pass what you know about the group; the tool echoes it back so you can build a programme from the returned activities. It does not check free dates and does not book anything. Choosing the price-list items: every item of get_price_list has an id, audience (who it is for) and occasions; pick the items that fit the conversation by their audience and occasions and pass their ids in item_ids - the tool and its view then show exactly these items. Without item_ids the tool filters the price list by group_type and occasion. Do not send personal data (names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, health information) in any parameter. Do not use to book (use create_prereservation) or for a single person's riding lesson (use get_activities or get_price_list). Do not use when the user only asks where Horseback is, how to get there or about transport, also for a group - use get_directions (it includes transport for groups). Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers). Quote forParticipants as returned (an individual quote stays an individual quote); do not offer items listed in excludedForAge.

budget_pln.description: Budget in PLN, total or per person (say which in notes).

group_type.description: Who is coming: individual, family, kindergarten, school, wtz (occupational therapy workshop, WTZ), company, public_office, or other.

item_ids.description: Ids of the price-list items (field id in get_price_list) that fit the group, chosen by their audience and occasions. The response and the view show exactly these items; unknown ids are ignored.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

notes.description: Anything else: duration, interests, accessibility needs of the group (no health details of individuals). Do not include personal data: names, contact details or health information.

occasion.description: Optional occasion: birthday, bachelor_party (bachelor or bachelorette party), wedding, first_communion, corporate_event (company event, team-building), school_trip, gift.

preferred_date.description: Preferred date or period, free text, e.g. "2026-05-14" or "May 2027".

name: get_group_trip_offer

accommodation.description: Accommodation and meals: OW Orle Gniazdo next to the centre (what is included in our packages, what guests book themselves).

excludedForAge.description: Items left out because the activity page gives a higher minimum age than the youngest age in ages - do not offer them to this group.

ignoredItemIds.description: item_ids from the call that are not in the price list (ignored).

location.description: Name and address of the centre.

audience.description: Who the item is for (audience): code and label in the language of the response.

forParticipants.description: Price for the number of participants from the call, computed from groupPricing - quote it as is (an individual quote stays an individual quote).

groupPricing.description: Group size rules from the activity page: tiers (price per group up to max people), chargeMin (smaller groups charged as this many people), quoteAbove (more people = individual quote).

id.description: Stable id of the price-list item (pass it in item_ids of get_group_trip_offer).

occasions.description: Occasions the item fits (may be empty): code and label in the language of the response.

request.description: The group details passed in the call, echoed back (null where not given).

selection.description: "item_ids": pricing.items are exactly the known item_ids passed in the call; "filter": no known item_ids were passed, items are filtered by group_type and occasion.
